## Chunks de R

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(reticulate)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
mtcars |> head()
```

```{r}
ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = wt, y = mpg, color = as.factor(cyl))) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  labs(title = "Peso vs. rendimiento", x = "Peso", y = "MPG", color = "Cilindros") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Chunks de Python

```{python}
import pandas as pd
import polars as pl
```

```{python}
df = pd.DataFrame({"x": [1, 2, 3], "y": [4, 5, 6]})
df.describe()
```

```{python}
df_pandas = pd.DataFrame({
    "producto": ["A", "B", "C"],
    "ventas": [100, 150, 200]
})
df_pandas
```

```{python}
df_polars = pl.DataFrame({
    "producto": ["A", "B", "C"],
    "ventas": [100, 150, 200]
})
df_polars
```

## Pasando datos de R a Python (opcional)

```{r}
mi_vector <- c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5)
```

```{python}
# Accede al objeto de R desde Python
print(r.mi_vector)
```
